name: Ally (Companion / Quartermaster)
motive: To carry the other half of the load, and to still be there at the hard part.
dread: Desertion: being the one who left, or the one who was left.
shadow: The Parasitic Sycophant: afraid to stand alone, it flatters, enables the delusion, and undermines anyone closer.
example: We do not sell you a licence and leave you a documentation portal. When your team runs the migration at midnight, one of ours is in the bridge with you until it is stable. That is what the contract means.
